standard.summary: Concept Geometry 的文本 embedding 当前使用 PyTorch 后端。
standard.effect: 该字段保留在配置中用于兼容，产品界面仅提供已实现的 PyTorch 路径。
standard.whenToUse: 启用语义 embedding 增强时保持默认值。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要在旧配置中手工指定尚未实现的 ONNX 后端。

optionDescriptions.pytorch: 使用 PyTorch 计算 embedding。

standard_en.summary: Concept Geometry currently computes its text embeddings on the PyTorch backend.
standard_en.effect: The field stays in the config for compatibility; the product UI offers only the PyTorch path, which is the one implemented.
standard_en.whenToUse: Leave it at the default when semantic embedding enhancement is enabled.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not hand-write the unimplemented ONNX backend into an old config.
